ana: FYI Skybridge (SBG-332) on hold. INV-2026-312 due 2026-03-08, amount $24,300. AP says a runtime test inflated usage by ~$4,200 and they want that portion credited. They offered wire $10k today and card update for rest.
maria: Any previous disputes?
kevin: No prior disputes. Last payment 2026-01-05. billing-bot: Charge attempt 2026-03-09 failed (insufficient funds).
sam: Sales wants to avoid churn. Recommend accepting partial wire and a simple 2-pay plan: 40% now, 60% in 30 days. Keep feature access for core product, suspend beta features until cleared.
maria: Finance: we can accept wire, require remittance and payer name. If telemetry confirms their test spike, issue credit up to verified amount.
kevin: Legal: we need a signed acknowledgement and "no waiver" clause. Also require agreement that payments are non-refundable pending final reconciliation.
after: Decision: send offer to customer with bank instructions, request remittance + signed plan, provisional credit up to $4,200 pending telemetry, hold beta features until first payment clears, escalate to collections if no response in 7 business days.
ana: Draft sent to ap@skybridge.io at 2026-03-10 14:08 UTC.
